title: LoRa L2 init: reject aborted or deinitializing state
description: Round-3 security review found lichen_lora_l2_init() returns idempotent success for every state other than UNINIT, including LORA_ABORTED after a queue-destroy failure and LORA_DEINITING. This falsely reports initialization although the queue is not reinitialized and start will fail. Limit idempotent success to fully initialized stable states and return an explicit error for aborted/deinitializing states.
acceptance_criteria: Init returns an error in ABORTED and DEINITING states and remains idempotently successful only for valid initialized stable states; tests/builds pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
